title: The Giant Turnip
moral: Even small strength becomes big strength when we join together!
notes: 영어 읽어 주기 대본. text 는 한국어 줄(키), en 이 읽는 문장. reuse 는 narration_el_en.js 의 영어 녹음 그대로, trim 은 from 줄의 영어 녹음을 같은 문장 경계에서 자른 것, new 만 새로 녹음한다. 배역·연기 지시는 read_script_el.json 의 같은 줄을 따른다.

acts.set:<spring|summer|feast>: 텃밭 배경 계절(gardenBG season) / 잔치 식탁. scenes[].set 으로 자동 호출
acts.seed:plant | sprout:show | water | sun |: 씨앗 심기·싹·물뿌리개·햇볕·순무 자라기(놀이판 연출 그대로, 누르기 없이)
acts.line:<n>: 옆모습 줄 서기(sideView n) — 앞 n 명이 순무 쪽으로 줄지어 잡는다
acts.pull:<n>: 앞 n 명이 다섯 번 당기는 연출(pullRound 의 누르기 없는 판)
acts.grandpa:fall | flop:all | cheer:all | si: 할아버지 엉덩방아 / 전원 벌렁 / 전원 만세 / 전원 주저앉기
acts.dog:bushout | cat:roofdown | mouse:holeo: 강아지 덤불에서 뛰어나옴 / 고양이 지붕에서 내려옴 / 생쥐 흙구멍에서 나옴 / 덤불 흔들림
acts.cut:<glare|heave|pop>: 그림 컷(강아지·고양이 째려보기, 영~차~ 두 장, 쑥!) — 컷 속 외침(VOICE_LINES cut_glare·cut_heave)은 그대로 재사용

lines.text: 봄이 왔어요. 할아버지가 텃밭에 구멍을 팠어요.
lines.en: Spring came. Grandpa dug a hole in the garden.
segs: Spring came. Grandpa dug a hole in the garden.

lines.text: 할아버지 손바닥 위에 작은 씨앗 하나가 또르르 굴렀어요.
lines.en: On Grandpa's palm, one teeny tiny seed rolled round and round.
segs: On Grandpa's palm, one teeny tiny seed rolled round and round.

lines.text: "순무야, 크게 자라라."
lines.from: "순무야, 크게 자라라." 씨앗을 톡 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: "Turnip, grow big and strong."

lines.text: 씨앗이 흙 속으로 쏙 들어갔어요.
lines.en: The seed slipped right into the soil.
segs: The seed slipped right into the soil.

lines.text: 할아버지는 흙을 토닥토닥 덮어 주고 집으로 돌아갔어요.
lines.en: Grandpa patted the soil down, pat, pat, pat, and went back home.
segs: Grandpa patted the soil down, pat, pat, pat, and went back home.

lines.text: 며칠 뒤, 할아버지가 씨앗을 심은 텃밭에 나왔어요.
lines.en: A few days later, Grandpa came to the garden where he had planted the seed.
segs: A few days later, Grandpa came to the garden where he had planted the seed.

lines.text: 파란 싹이 났어요! 물도 주고 햇볕도 줘요.
lines.en: A green sprout popped up! It gets water and sunshine too.
segs: A green sprout popped up! It gets water and sunshine too.

lines.text: 할아버지는 날마다 텃밭에 나와 싹을 요리조리 들여다보았어요.
lines.en: Every day Grandpa came out to the garden and peered at the little sprout, this way and that.
segs: Every day Grandpa came out to the garden and peered at the little sprout, this way and that.

lines.text: 싹은 쑥쑥, 잎은 넓적넓적 자라났지요.
lines.en: The sprout shot up, and the leaves grew wide and broad.
segs: The sprout shot up, and the leaves grew wide and broad.

lines.text: 여름이 되었어요. 순무 잎이 할아버지 키만큼 자랐어요!
lines.en: Summer came. The turnip leaves grew as tall as Grandpa!
segs: Summer came. The turnip leaves grew as tall as Grandpa!

lines.text: 땅속 뿌리도 무럭무럭, 커다랗게 자랐지요.
lines.en: And under the ground, the root grew and grew, bigger and bigger, too.
segs: And under the ground, the root grew and grew, bigger and bigger, too.

lines.text: 여름날, 할아버지가 커다란 순무 앞에 섰어요.
lines.en: One summer day, Grandpa stood before the big turnip.
segs: One summer day, Grandpa stood before the big turnip.

lines.text: "이제 뽑을 때가 되었구나." 할아버지가 손바닥을 탁탁 쳤어요.
lines.en: "It is time to pull it up," said Grandpa, and he clapped his hands, clap, clap.
segs: "It is time to pull it up," said Grandpa, and he clapped his hands, clap, clap.

lines.text: 할아버지가 순무 잎을 꽉 잡았어요.
lines.from: 할아버지가 순무 잎을 꽉 잡았어요. 톡 눌러서 영차!
lines.en: Grandpa grabbed the turnip leaves tight.
segs: Grandpa grabbed the turnip leaves tight.

lines.text: 영차! 할아버지가 잎을 힘껏 당겼어요.
lines.en: Heave-ho! Grandpa pulled hard on the leaves.
segs: Heave-ho! Grandpa pulled hard on the leaves.

lines.text: 순무는 꿈쩍도 안 해요.
lines.en: The turnip won't budge.

lines.text: 아이코! 할아버지가 엉덩방아를 찧었어요.
lines.en: Oof! Grandpa plopped down on the ground.
segs: Grandpa plopped down on the ground.

lines.text: 혼자서는 안 되겠어요. 할아버지가 할머니를 불러요!
lines.en: Grandpa can't do it alone. Grandpa calls Grandma!
segs: Grandpa can't do it alone. Grandpa calls Grandma!

lines.text: 할머니는 앞치마를 두른 채 부엌에서 후다닥 뛰어나왔어요.
lines.en: Grandma came dashing out of the kitchen, pitter-patter, still wearing her apron.
segs: Grandma came dashing out of the kitchen, pitter-patter, still wearing her apron.

lines.text: 텃밭에서 할아버지가 순무 곁에 기다리고 있었어요.
lines.en: Grandpa waited beside the turnip in the garden.
segs: Grandpa waited beside the turnip in the garden.

lines.text: 할머니가 달려왔어요. "같이 해 봐요!"
lines.en: Grandma came running. "Let's do it together!"

lines.text: 할머니가 할아버지 허리를 꽉 잡았어요. 영차!
lines.en: Grandma held on tight to Grandpa's waist. Heave-ho!
segs: Grandma held on tight to Grandpa's waist. Heave-ho!

lines.text: 순무가 한 뼘 올라왔어요! 그래도 안 뽑혀요.
lines.en: The turnip came up a little! But it still won't come out.
segs: The turnip came up a little! But it still won't come out.

lines.text: "손녀야, 이리 와서 좀 도와주렴!"
lines.en: Sweetie, come here and help us!
segs: Sweetie, come here and help us!

lines.text: 텃밭의 할아버지와 할머니는 손녀를 기다렸어요.
lines.en: Grandpa and Grandma waited for their granddaughter in the garden.
segs: Grandpa and Grandma waited for their granddaughter in the garden.

lines.text: 마당에서 놀던 손녀가 깡충깡충 달려왔어요.
lines.en: The granddaughter, who was playing in the yard, came skipping over.
segs: The granddaughter, who was playing in the yard, came skipping over.

lines.text: "손녀야~!" 손녀가 할머니 허리를 잡았어요. 영차!
lines.en: "Sweetie~!" The granddaughter held Grandma's waist. Heave-ho!
segs: The granddaughter held Grandma's waist. Heave-ho!

lines.text: 조금 더 올라왔어요!
lines.from: 조금 더 올라왔어요! 누가 더 도와줄까요?
lines.en: It came up a little more!
segs: It came up a little more!

lines.text: 세 사람이 영차영차 당겨도 순무는 땅속에 꼭 박혀 있었어요.
lines.en: Even with three of them pulling, heave-ho, heave-ho, the turnip was still stuck fast in the ground.
segs: Even with three of them pulling, heave-ho, heave-ho, the turnip was still stuck fast in the ground.

lines.text: 세 사람이 당기는 텃밭 옆에서 소리가 났어요.
lines.en: A sound came from beside the garden where the three were pulling.
segs: A sound came from beside the garden where the three were pulling.

lines.text: 덤불 뒤에서 멍멍!
lines.en: Woof woof from behind the bush!
segs: Woof woof from behind the bush!

lines.text: 강아지가 뛰어나왔어요. "나도 도울게요!"
lines.en: The puppy came bounding out. "I'll help too!"

lines.text: "멍멍! 저도 힘이 아주 세요!"
lines.en: Woof woof! I am very, very strong!
segs: Woof woof! I am very, very strong!

lines.text: 강아지가 손녀 치마를 꼭 붙잡았어요. 영차!
lines.en: The puppy held the granddaughter's skirt tight. Heave-ho!
segs: The puppy held the granddaughter's skirt tight. Heave-ho!

lines.text: 순무가 꿈틀, 조금 더 올라왔지만 아직도 뽑히지 않았어요.
lines.en: The turnip wiggled up a bit more, but it still would not come out.
segs: The turnip wiggled up a bit more, but it still would not come out.

lines.text: 텃밭에서는 강아지까지 넷이 힘을 쓰고 있었어요.
lines.en: In the garden, all four, including Dog, were pulling hard.
segs: In the garden, all four, including Dog, were pulling hard.

lines.text: 헛간 지붕에서 야옹!
lines.en: Meow from the barn roof!

lines.text: 고양이가 지붕에서 폴짝 내려왔어요.
lines.en: The cat hopped down from the roof.
segs: The cat hopped down from the roof.

lines.text: 어? 강아지랑 고양이가 서로 째려봐요.
lines.en: Huh? The puppy and the cat are glaring at each other.
segs: Huh? The puppy and the cat are glaring at each other.

lines.text: "흥, 알았어!" 그래도 고양이가 강아지 꼬리를 꼭 잡았어요.
lines.en: "Hmph!" But the cat held the puppy's tail tight anyway.
segs: But the cat held the puppy's tail tight anyway.

lines.text: 다섯이 영차영차 당겨도 순무는 꼼짝하지 않았어요.
lines.en: Even with five of them pulling, heave-ho, heave-ho, the turnip did not budge.
segs: Even with five of them pulling, heave-ho, heave-ho, the turnip did not budge.

lines.text: 휴우, 모두 지쳐서 털썩 주저앉았어요.
lines.en: Phew, everyone got tired and plopped down.
segs: Phew, everyone got tired and plopped down.

lines.text: 다섯이 텃밭에 앉아 쉬는데 작은 소리가 났어요.
lines.en: As the five rested in the garden, a tiny sound came.
segs: As the five rested in the garden, a tiny sound came.

lines.text: 흙구멍에서 찍찍 소리가 나요.
lines.from: 흙구멍에서 찍찍 소리가 나요. 톡 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: Squeak, squeak from a hole in the ground.
segs: Squeak, squeak from a hole in the ground.

lines.text: 아주 작은 생쥐가 쪼르르 나왔어요.
lines.en: A teeny tiny mouse scurried out.
segs: A teeny tiny mouse scurried out.

lines.text: "너무 작아서 안 될 거야~"
lines.en: "You're too small. It won't work~"
segs: You're too small. It won't work~

lines.text: "나도 할래요!" 생쥐가 고양이 꼬리를 꼭 잡았어요.
lines.en: "Me too!" The mouse held the cat's tail tight.
segs: The mouse held the cat's tail tight.

lines.text: 모두 벌떡 일어나 앞사람을 꼭 붙잡았어요.
lines.en: Everyone jumped right up and held on tight to the one in front.
segs: Everyone jumped right up and held on tight to the one in front.

lines.text: 텃밭에 선 여섯은 순무를 다시 당겼어요.
lines.en: The six stood in the garden and pulled the turnip again.
segs: The six stood in the garden and pulled the turnip again.

lines.text: 이번엔 여섯이 다 함께!
lines.from: 이번엔 여섯이 다 함께! 순무를 톡톡 눌러요. 영~차!
lines.en: This time, all six together!

lines.text: 영차, 영차! 순무가 흔들흔들 움직이기 시작했어요.
lines.en: Heave-ho, heave-ho! The turnip began to wobble and wiggle.
segs: Heave-ho, heave-ho! The turnip began to wobble and wiggle.

lines.text: 쑥! 커다란 순무가 뽑혔어요! 모두 벌렁 넘어졌어요.
lines.en: Pop! The big turnip came out! Everyone tumbled over backwards.
segs: Pop! The big turnip came out! Everyone tumbled over backwards.

lines.text: 작은 생쥐까지 모두 힘을 모았더니 뽑혔어요!
lines.en: When everyone, even the tiny mouse, pulled together, it came out!
segs: When everyone, even the tiny mouse, pulled together, it came out!

lines.text: "고맙다, 얘들아! 생쥐야, 너도 정말 고맙구나."
lines.en: Thank you, everyone! And thank you too, little mouse.
segs: Thank you, everyone! And thank you too, little mouse.

lines.text: 순무를 뽑은 여섯은 집에 모였어요.
lines.en: After pulling up the turnip, all six gathered in the house.
segs: After pulling up the turnip, all six gathered in the house.

lines.text: 할아버지는 순무를 숭덩숭덩 썰고, 할머니는 커다란 냄비를 꺼냈어요.
lines.en: Grandpa chopped the turnip, chop, chop, chop, and Grandma brought out her biggest pot.
segs: Grandpa chopped the turnip, chop, chop, chop, and Grandma brought out her biggest pot.

lines.text: 맛있는 순무국을 끓였어요.
lines.en: They cooked yummy turnip soup.

lines.text: 보글보글, 구수한 냄새가 온 집 안에 퍼졌어요.
lines.en: Bubble, bubble! A warm, tasty smell filled the whole house.
segs: Bubble, bubble! A warm, tasty smell filled the whole house.

lines.text: 순무국을 한 그릇씩 나눠 줘요.
lines.from: 순무국을 한 그릇씩 나눠 줘요. 냄비를 톡 눌러요!
lines.en: Let's share the soup, one bowl each.
segs: Let's share the soup, one bowl each.

lines.text: 여섯 그릇, 여섯 명! 딱 맞아요.
lines.en: Six bowls for six friends! Just right.
segs: Six bowls for six friends! Just right.

lines.text: 모두 함께 맛있게 먹었답니다.
lines.en: They all ate it up together, yum.
segs: They all ate it up together, yum.

lines.text: 작은 힘도 모이면 커다란 힘이 된답니다.
lines.en: Even the smallest strength becomes great big strength when everyone joins together.
segs: Even the smallest strength becomes great big strength when everyone joins together.
